name: Veranda High Resort, MGallery Chiang Mai
positioning: Hillside MGallery resort in a valley of rice and tea terraces in Hang Dong, outside Chiang Mai, with a rooftop infinity pool and contemporary Lanna design (officially Veranda High Resort Chiang Mai - MGallery Collection)
best_for: Couples wanting a valley-view retreat with private spa cottages
Families wanting pool villas, a kids' club and hands-on cultural activities

facts.text: The resort is part of MGallery by Accor and is set on a hillside in Hang Dong district, Chiang Mai.
The resort is divided into two zones: one represents the cultural heritage of northern Thailand, the other the contemporary Veranda style.
The resort is a compound of timber and concrete structures scattered across a valley of rice paddies, wildflowers and tropical greenery.
All rooms feature contemporary Lanna design, a bathtub and a private balcony with mountain or garden views.
The Luxury Pool Villa has three bedrooms, a private pool, a fully equipped kitchen and a poolside dining area.
The Presidential Pool Villa has a private pool, a private garden, a terrace with panoramic valley views and dedicated Villa Host service.
Rabiang Cha restaurant is a modern version of a traditional northern rice granary.
The Higher Room is the all-day dining restaurant, with outdoor seating looking over the infinity-edged pool and the valley.
The Cultural Pavilion offers Thai cooking, yoga and Muay Thai.
Guests can join a hands-on rice planting experience in the rice field.
Morning alms giving introduces guests to Thai Buddhist tradition.
The Kids' Club has educational toys and a daily programme of indoor and outdoor activities, and a separate children's pool sits alongside the infinity pool.

highlights.text: Accommodations are set on a scenic valley slope with views over rice and tea terraces and multiple water features.
The infinity pool is on the roof terrace of the main building, overlooking the valley.
Each spa cottage is a self-contained private spa with a large sunken bath, a steam shower and twin treatment beds suited to couples; treatment products were developed by the resort's own therapist.
A tunnel of polished concrete cooled by falling water forms the entrance into the resort's inner courtyard.
Room types with private pools include the Plunge Pool Pavilion, the Pool Villa and the Presidential Pool Villa.

considerations.text: The resort is outside the city, about a 30-minute drive from downtown Chiang Mai.
Doi Suthep Temple is about 50 minutes from the resort.
